meta.title: Kimi Coding models and quota
meta.description: Keeps this profile's kimi-coding route in step with Kimi Coding's live model catalog: open Settings → Kimi Coding to check and sync models (optionally on startup or on an interval), set each model's context window and output cap, and read the 5-hour and 7-day subscription quota with reset countdowns. While a conversation uses Kimi Coding, a compact quota pill can sit in the chat input. Model and quota reads contact api.kimi.com with your configured credential; API keys never leave the Host. Requires a profile whose llm-pi-ai route declares kimi-coding.
